purpose: Define the official BI collage UI pages, components, actions, evidence, and safety boundaries shared by testcase generation, package lint, helper planning, and result gates.

pages.purpose: Official BI entry page after auth and lease navigation.
Project/report list reached through My Custom > Collage Report.
Official collage report editor where metric rows, formulas, preview, save, and download flows are operated.

locatorStrategies: visible text for stable menu labels
role=button or role=treeitem with expanded state when exposed
nearby text fallback for nested menu items
interactionHazards: same text reused across navigation levels

components.purpose: Read available projects/reports or detect a no-project state.
locatorStrategies: heading or table/list landmark near collage report page
row container containing source report control and field control
nth row only after reading visible row count
interactionHazards: global text lookup may pick an option outside the target row
row DOM can rerender after source report changes

components.purpose: Select the source report for a metric row.
locatorStrategies: popover option text within the opened source picker

components.purpose: Select the metric field after source report is selected.
locatorStrategies: field option text inside current picker only
interactionHazards: field picker can keep stale options after source report switch
same field names can exist under different source reports

actions.purpose: Configure one or more official collage metric rows by source report and field.

policy: Helper emits current-run evidence only and never judges PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED.
Raw DOM and screenshots are artifacts for review, not the stable contract.
Tool Bridge response is conditional evidence and is required only when irreversible/native dialog execution is reached.
Official collage testcases should express metric setup as metrics[].sourceReport + metrics[].field.
Legacy field/sourceReport params may be normalized by compatibility code, but new cases should not rely on natural-language-only field setup.

forbidden: direct product API as testcase result source
